verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Intel publishes an llms.txt at intel.com (HTTP 200), so an agent can be pointed at vendor-provided, agent-oriented docs. However, it is a corporate-level file describing Intel in general, and the pack does not show that it covers the Core Ultra 9 285K's specs or developer docs. Missing for 10: evidence the llms.txt indexes 285K product and spec pages, agent-oriented developer docs (e.g. for oneAPI or OpenVINO on this chip), and any hands-on corroboration of agent use.
